RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel is a recognized risk factor for unconscious bias and reflects poor diversity practices, but it does not alone establish discrimination. For senior hospital roles, selection committees often prioritize generalized executive leadership over technical or academic credentials (such as a PhD versus an MSc).

Before raising bias, follow up politely on your request for written feedback, as two-week administrative delays are routine. Meanwhile, review institutional hiring policies to determine whether panel diversity was mandated. If the explanation remains withheld, appears arbitrary, or reveals criteria were applied inconsistently, consult a union representative or employment advisor before formally challenging the decision. Prematurely alleging discrimination without documentation can compromise your position.
